_source: docs/design-bible.md: Bosses (Role and mechanics, Shift Action columns only; no Lore), Boss stat scaling, Boss templates, Damage dice, Encounter and boss defaults. Placeholders in text: {dmg:N:dX} = N% of benchmark DPR as dice of size dX (d6 if left out), {hp:N} = N% of the boss's max HP, {bpb:N} = N x Boss PB, {dc} = the boss's save DC. Every attack sets its own "die" (bible: Damage dice).

genericLegendaryActions.name: Move
genericLegendaryActions.text: Moves up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

attacks.name: Columnar Slam
attacks.text: Pushes the target 10 ft and raises a 5 ft pillar in its old space.

specials.name: Magnetic Pull (recharge 5-6)
specials.text: 30 ft line. DC {dc} Str save or be pulled adjacent to it with speed 0 until its next turn.

specials.name: Lens Flare (Bloodied)
specials.text: One creature looking at it makes a DC {dc} Wis save or is Charmed until the end of its next turn, drawn toward it.

shiftAction.name: Piston Floor
shiftAction.text: Three 10 ft hex sections rise 15 ft into pillars or drop 10 ft into pits. Creatures on them make a DC {dc} Dex save or fall prone.

bosses.name: Choir of the Hollow Column
bosses.role: Stationary artillery with 4 destructible pipe clusters.

attacks.name: Resonant Blast
attacks.text: 30 ft cone. On a failed save, also Deafened and pushed 10 ft. Each destroyed cluster cuts this damage by a quarter.

specials.name: Hymn Aura
specials.text: Creatures starting a turn within 5 ft per surviving cluster take {dmg:15:d6} thunder damage.

shiftAction.name: Acoustic Shift
shiftAction.text: The outer walls slide into new chambers. Creatures within 10 ft of a wall make a DC {dc} Con save or take PB d6 thunder damage and are pushed 15 ft toward the center.

bosses.name: Gilded Excavation Herd
bosses.role: Summoner and pack controller: a golem and two hounds.

attacks.name: Hound Bite
attacks.text: One per hound. DC {dc} Str save or prone.

specials.name: Tether Beam (bonus action, recharge 4-6)
specials.text: 60 ft. DC {dc} Dex save or be tethered to the nearest pillar, limited to 15 ft of it, until the pillar is smashed (AC 15, {bpb:10} HP).

shiftAction.name: Conveyor Shift
shiftAction.text: Two 15 ft strips of floor slide 20 ft in opposite directions, carrying creatures and pillars and breaking or stretching tethers.

bosses.name: Kaelen and Vyr, the Fractured Striders
bosses.role: Dual-form skirmisher that swaps forms each round or after heavy damage.

attacks.name: Cleave
attacks.text: Splashes {dmg:10} onto a second creature within 5 ft. DC {dc} Str save or Topple (prone).

attacks.name: Ricochet Bolt
attacks.text: Bounces to a second target for half damage.

specials.name: Form Swap
specials.text: Swaps forms at the start of each turn, or when it takes {hp:25} damage in one turn.

specials.name: High Ground
specials.text: As Vyr, teleports 30 ft to high ground as a bonus action.

shiftAction.name: Echo Swap
shiftAction.text: The walls rotate 90 degrees, carrying creatures within 5 ft of them, and the active form leaves a crystal afterimage that explodes for force damage at the end of the round.

specials.name: Snare Shard (bonus action)
specials.text: Next round it arms as a random floor 1 or 2 room trick.

specials.name: Lethality Contract
specials.text: The lowest-HP player takes +{bpb:1} damage from him, and he regains {hp:10} HP when they drop.

specials.name: Lodge Escape (reaction, once)
specials.text: Below a quarter HP, he moves half his speed without provoking.

shiftAction.name: Trophy Gallery
shiftAction.text: Four statues slide across the arena on floor tracks. Creatures in their path take PB d8 bludgeoning damage (DC {dc} Dex save halves), and the statues block line of sight.

bosses.name: The Lattice Spinner
traits: Climb speed; walks on walls and ceilings.

specials.name: Web Shot (recharge 5-6)
specials.text: DC {dc} Dex save or Restrained.

specials.name: Transit Cable (bonus action)
specials.text: Strings a cable between two columns within 60 ft, up to 4 at once. Crossing one deals {dmg:25:d6} lightning damage and teleports the creature 15 ft toward the Spinner.

shiftAction.name: Loom Rotation
shiftAction.text: Every column shifts 15 ft clockwise, dragging its cables along. Creatures in the sweep make a DC {dc} Dex save.

attacks.name: Rift Barrage
attacks.text: Ranged spell attacks. Each leaves a pool of raw stride energy: difficult terrain that Restrains creatures ending their turn in it.

specials.name: Surge Aura
specials.text: Creatures starting a turn within 10 ft take {dmg:15:d6} force damage.

specials.name: Crystallize (Bloodied)
specials.text: Three Quantum Basalt shards form on its shell (AC 15, {bpb:5} HP each). Breaking all three Stuns it until the end of its next turn.

legendaryOptions.name: Pulse
legendaryOptions.text: Its Surge Aura deals damage again.

shiftAction.name: Tilt the Gate
shiftAction.text: The room tilts 20 degrees in a random direction. Every creature makes a DC {dc} Str or Dex save or slides 15 ft downhill, and the pools slide with it.

bosses.name: General Vane of the Tenth Stride

specials.name: Phalanx Stance
specials.text: Resistance to damage from the front, and ranged attacks that miss him rebound at the attacker.

specials.name: Stampede Stance
specials.text: +20 ft speed; moves through creatures' spaces (DC {dc} Str save or prone and {dmg:15} damage).

specials.name: Swap Stance
specials.text: Bonus action.

shiftAction.name: Marching Columns
shiftAction.text: A phalanx of stone walls rises at one end and marches 15 ft each round, crushing anyone caught against the room's edge.

specials.name: Severing
specials.text: Starts with 3 heads, one each for fire, lightning and cold. A head is severed by 8 x PB damage in one turn (the players' PB), leaving an Elemental Residue puddle. Two light-heads grow back at the end of its turn, up to 6 heads. Light-heads never regrow.

shiftAction.name: Refraction Shift
shiftAction.text: Floor panels flip to polished mirrors. Any beam, line or ranged spell this round reflects to hit a second random creature within 15 ft.

specials.name: Unseen Seams
specials.text: Attacks from creatures looking at it have disadvantage. A creature can avert its eyes, becoming Blinded to the Architect alone until the start of its next turn.

specials.name: Fold (recharge 5-6)
specials.text: One creature within 60 ft makes a DC {dc} Cha save or is teleported to a space the Architect chooses.

shiftAction.name: Fold Space
shiftAction.text: The room folds in half or swaps its north and south halves, changing who is adjacent and breaking line of sight.

specials.name: Unseen Angles
specials.text: Each member is immune to damage from any creature that moved closer to it this turn.

legendaryOptions.name: Ray
legendaryOptions.text: One member fires an Angle Ray.

shiftAction.name: Perspective Collapse
shiftAction.text: Gravity reorients to the wall nearest the member with the most HP, dropping creatures up to 20 ft onto the new floor.

specials.name: Attunement
specials.text: At the start of each round, gains corrupted versions of the party's two most common tags' Resonance riders.

specials.name: Erasure (recharge 5-6)
specials.text: 30 ft sphere. DC {dc} Wis save or take {dmg:50:d6} necrotic damage, and one non-evolved boon is suppressed until the end of the target's next turn.

shiftAction.name: Slot Scramble
shiftAction.text: The floor breaks into 4 islands over 15 ft chasms of void, and each player has one random non-evolved boon suppressed until they cross to a different island.

bosses.name: Ophaniel of the Inverted Bloom
bosses.role: The Wounded Idol, then The Gate Opens at Bloodied.

attacks.name: Inverted Gravity Beam
attacks.text: 60 ft line. On a failed save, the target also falls upward 20 ft.

specials.name: Paradise Spores (recharge 5-6)
specials.text: 30 ft cone. DC {dc} Wis save or Charmed and moving toward it.

specials.name: The Gate Opens (Phase 2, Bloodied)
specials.text: All its damage gains a 20% radiant or necrotic rider, and it gains 1 extra Legendary Action.

shiftAction.name: Paradise Bleed
shiftAction.text: Half the arena becomes paradise, where creatures regain HP each turn but take double damage; the other half becomes airless shattered stone with Silence and necrotic damage. The halves swap or rotate every round.

bosses.name: The Sun-Eater's Husk
bosses.role: Starving Gold, then Supernova Core at Bloodied.

attacks.name: Antler Rake
attacks.text: 20 ft cone. On a failed save, also Topple (prone) and push 15 ft.

specials.name: Devour Light (bonus action)
specials.text: Ends one magical effect or light source within 60 ft and regains {hp:5} HP.

specials.name: Supernova Core (Phase 2, Bloodied)
specials.text: The shell shatters and its AC drops by 2. A Gravitational Pulse pulls everyone 15 ft toward it at the start of its turn.

specials.name: Core Flare (Phase 2, recharge 5-6)
specials.text: 20 ft sphere. DC {dc} save or take {dmg:60:d8} radiant damage.

shiftAction.name: Eclipse Cycle
shiftAction.text: Rounds alternate between Blinding Zenith (2 x PB radiant damage and Blinded for creatures out of cover) and Total Umbra (magical darkness beyond 10 ft of the boss, with 2 x PB cold or necrotic damage in the dark).

bosses.name: The Gatewright
bosses.role: The Master Builder, then The Fractured Horizon at Bloodied.

attacks.name: Builder's Strike
attacks.text: Each hit raises a 10 ft wall segment within 30 ft.

attacks.name: Portal Strike
attacks.text: Each fired from any of its three portals.

specials.name: The Master Builder (Phase 1)
specials.text: Triggers two floor 4 room tricks each round on initiative count 0.

specials.name: The Fractured Horizon (Phase 2, Bloodied)
specials.text: Three portals open across the arena.

legendaryOptions.name: Raise Wall
legendaryOptions.text: Raises a 10 ft wall segment within 30 ft.

shiftAction.name: Grand Reconstruction
shiftAction.text: The arena cycles through the geometry of floors 1 to 4 each round, triggering that floor's signature hazard.
